title: Elijah Goes Up to Heaven
traveler_why: Scout is the Traveler who looks closely and sees, and tonight Elisha keeps his eyes on Elijah to the very end and sees the chariot: Scout watches Grandpa water the tomatoes, takes his watering can, and keeps the garden growing.
traveler_about: Scout fits tonight because Elisha kept his eyes open and watched everything, right to the very end. In Scout’s world today: Grandpa is going on a long trip, so he shows Scout how to water the tomato plants. Scout watches every step. Fill the can. Water the roots, not the leaves. Then Grandpa hands Scout his own green watering can. All week, Scout keeps the garden growing. Just like Elisha picking up Elijah’s coat, Scout learned that when someone good hands you their work, you carry it on.
